name: The Broad
notes: Diller Scofidio + Renfro's Broad (2015) on Grand Avenue: the 'veil', a white lattice of cells over glass, drawn here as white fins and bands on every face and a lattice roof with skylights; the concrete 'vault' of the collection store glimpsed through it; the veil lifted like a curtain at the two corners on Grand Avenue over the glass lobby; the oculus dimple in the Grand Avenue face; the olive-tree plaza to the south-west. On the downtown grid's bearing (front facing north-west onto Grand Avenue), rasterised in rows. Sizes (about 64 by 60 m, 32 m high) and the lattice pitch are guessed from general knowledge; the lattice's real cells are rhomboid and deep, which the parts can only suggest. No photographs were available.
